title: 第1316章 疯狂突破战力飙升两章合一第1315章 大势压来风雨飘摇两章合一
slug: 末世我的女人有亿点强
lines: 时间过得飞快，无论外界如何议论，风波如何之大。
林羽都两耳不闻窗外事，沉寂在道炉之中，专心修行永恒不灭经，熬炼体魄。
转眼一晃。
他在玉京禁地中，已经待了一个多月了。
“轰隆隆！”
道炉之内，神光冲天，火焰与雷霆共舞，淹没了整片虚空，将他包裹在其中，如同祭炼兵器一般焚烧熬炼自身。
在他面前，一座白玉雷池沉沉浮浮。
其中的神液如同不要钱般，疯狂的朝着他的口中汹涌而入。
那可是聚天地精华，吸混沌之气，在雷海之中历经无尽岁月孕育出来的至宝，是吸收天劫之力演化出道则的宝液。
一滴就能令人踏足雷霆大道中。
而此刻，一池雷劫液足足十大碗，都如同不要钱般朝着林羽的口中涌了进去。
不断的熬炼与修复他的躯体。
随着雷劫液这种无上至宝入体，林羽周身都散发出了浓郁到化不开的神光，气血更是滔滔如大江浪潮，席卷天上地下。
一道道的神环自他血肉中呈现了出来，晶莹剔透。
“第七门，惊门，开！”
伴随着林羽的一声怒吼，他的身体宛如撕开了一般，传出了一道震天的声响。
体内。
第七道门出现，演化混沌，演化天地万物，正在疯狂的吸收着雷劫液中的神能，同时勾动体内的进化之门，释放人体最深处的潜能。
不断交融，不断碰撞，借此产生出更加神异的力量，汇聚在一起。
逐渐演化出了一道门的形态。
这便是人体秘境第七门，惊门！
“轰隆！”
惊门形成，顿时与体内其他六门产生了感应，神异的力量流动间，一道神秘的大道纹路自他头顶百会穴的位置汹涌而出。
那是第一门，开门的位置。
神异力量始于开门，化成一道特殊的大道纹络，瞬间贯穿过一道又一道的门，将七道门彻底连接了起来，一同发光，一同震动。
“大道贯穿七门，主人这是永恒不灭经小成了！”
一旁，天鹏早就被吓得远远的飞开，远离了这片区域。
他也是领悟了不灭经的，但到了此刻，也不过开到第三门而已，用永恒不灭经来修行，难度比正常的开门何止难了千万倍。
也只有林羽这种妖孽，本身资质体魄就强横，才能在如此短的时间内，冲入第七门。
当然……
这一切最重要的，还得是林羽手中的资源太丰富太珍贵了。
短短一个半月，龙血草以及各种珍稀兽血全部消耗干净，仅剩下龙血和凤血没动，就连朱雀真血都已经用掉了。
而这都还不够，将更加珍贵的雷劫液都消耗了。
他一共得到三池白玉雷池。
其中第一池用在拍卖会换取宝物消耗了一些，几乎还剩下一半的样子，可都已经全部消耗干净了。
如今眼前这一池，已经是第二池了，而且看样子已经快见底了，可见林羽这次闭关消耗了多少恐怖的资源。
“轰隆！”
这时，漫天神光、雷霆火焰化作一道道神华，快速缩回了林羽的体内，纷纷内敛。
露出了一具雄伟的身躯，盘坐在道炉之中。
肌肤晶莹如玉，道道血气神环笼罩在肌体之中，让他看起来圣神不可侵犯，整个人都散发着不朽不灭的神光，熠熠生辉。
content_en:
Time flies so fast, no matter how the outside world talks about it or how big the turmoil is.
Lin Yu didn't listen to what was happening outside the window, and remained silent in the Tao furnace, concentrating on practicing the Eternal Immortality Sutra and tempering his body.
In a blink of an eye.
He has been in the forbidden area of ​​Yujing for more than a month.
"Boom!"
Within the furnace, divine light soared into the sky, flames and thunder danced together, flooding the entire void, wrapping him in it, burning and refining himself like a sacrificial weapon.
In front of him, a white jade thunder pool floated.
The divine liquid in it surged crazily into his mouth as if it was free of charge.
It is a treasure that gathers the essence of heaven and earth, absorbs the energy of chaos, and is bred through endless years in the sea of ​​thunder. It is a treasure liquid that absorbs the power of heavenly calamity and evolves the Tao.
One drop can set people on the Thunder Road.
At this moment, a pool of ten bowls of Thunder Tribulation Liquid poured into Lin Yu's mouth as if it was free of charge.
Constantly refining and repairing his body.
As the supreme treasure of Thunder Tribulation Liquid entered his body, Lin Yu's whole body emitted an indescribably rich divine light, and his energy and blood surged like the tide of a river, sweeping across the sky and the earth.
Divine rings emerged from his flesh and blood, crystal clear.
"The seventh door, the shocking door, open!"
Following Lin Yu's roar, his body seemed to be torn apart, and a shocking sound came out.
in vivo.
The seventh gate appears, evolving chaos and all things in the world. It is frantically absorbing the divine energy in the Thunder Tribulation Liquid, and at the same time triggers the door of evolution in the body to release the deepest potential of the human body.
Continuously blending and colliding, thereby producing more magical power and gathering together.
Gradually it evolved into the shape of a door.
This is the seventh gate of the secret realm of the human body, the shocking gate!
"Boom!"
The Jingmen was formed, and it immediately reacted with the other six gates in the body. During the flow of magical power, a mysterious avenue pattern surged out from the Baihui point on the top of his head.
That's the first door, where it opens.
The supernatural power starts from opening the door and turns into a special avenue pattern, which instantly penetrates one door after another, completely connecting the seven doors, shining together and vibrating together.
"The great road runs through the seven gates. Master, this is the completion of the Eternal Sutra!"
On the side, Tianpeng had long been frightened and flew away, far away from this area.
He also understood the Immortal Sutra, but at this moment, he has only opened the third door. Practicing with the Eternal Immortal Sutra is thousands of times more difficult than opening the door normally.
Only an evildoer like Lin Yu, with his powerful aptitude and physique, could break into the seventh gate in such a short period of time.
Of course...
The most important thing about all this is that the resources in Lin Yu's hands are too rich and precious.
In just one and a half months, all the dragon blood grass and all kinds of rare animal blood were consumed, leaving only the dragon blood and phoenix blood untouched, and even the Suzaku true blood had been used up.
And this was not enough, the more precious Thunder Tribulation Liquid was consumed.
He got three white jade thunder pools in total.
Some of the first pool was used in exchange for treasures at the auction, and almost half of it was left, but it had all been consumed.
The pool in front of him is now the second pool, and it seems to have almost bottomed out. This shows how many terrifying resources Lin Yu has consumed in this retreat.
"Boom!"
At this time, the divine light and thunderous flames in the sky turned into streaks of divine glory, quickly retracted into Lin Yu's body, and they all restrained themselves.
A majestic body was revealed, sitting cross-legged in the furnace.
His skin was as crystal clear as jade, and the divine rings of blood and energy shrouded his body, making him look like the Holy Spirit was inviolable. His whole body exuded immortal light and shone brightly.
